_notes: 361 keys reviewed, 0 null. Team name normalised to 'Hangyul-ийн баг' (EN 'Hangyul team'), as in mn-student-mobile.

OWNER DECISION: the current English still says 'your counselor' in ~40 deep keys (visaroute, concierge, success, writing). Mongolian keeps 'зөвлөх тань' there to follow the English. The mn-student-mobile patch replaced it with the team; if the English moves to 'the Hangyul team', these keys should follow.
'визний' spelling unified to 'визийн' (matches 'визийн бичиг баримтын бэлтгэл'); 'консулын легализаци' unified to 'консулын баталгаажуулалт'.
'багц' kept only for plan: document set = 'иж бүрдэл', phone plan = 'утасны тариф'. Admission letter = 'элсэлтийн зөвшөөрөл'; admitted = 'элсэлтэд тэнцлээ' (not 'элслээ' = enrolled).
Residence card: full 'гадаад иргэний бүртгэлийн үнэмлэх' at first mention, short 'бүртгэлийн үнэмлэх' in follow-up lines (kept as is).
Em dashes in cur where the English now uses full stops were kept unless the line was otherwise patched; they read naturally in Mongolian.
